subject: general
question:
The record of the enrollment of boys and girls in a school over 6 years has been presented in the following bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a5ad8d370b815a6cc52cd5455d2c6699c84c45485106bc08d6b690e38db691b.png] 

In which year was the total enrollment the minimum?
solution:
Total number of enrollment

**In 1995 = 424**

In 1996 = 425

In 1997 = 540

In 1998 = 478

In 1999 = 518

In 2000 = 517

**∴ In 1995, total number of enrollment was minimum.**
